map.四分位数最适合「带极端值的分布描述」：收入、房价、响应时间这类长尾数据，均值容易: Quartiles best describe distributions with extremes: for long-tailed data such as income, house prices and response times the mean is easily lifted by a few very large values, while Q1-Q3 cover the middle 50% and come closer to most people's experience. map.为什么不同软件算出的 Q₁ 不一样？: Why do different programs give different Q₁ values?
map.分位位置定义不同：本页 pos=(n−1)p（type 7/INC），Tukey: The percentile position is defined differently: this page uses pos=(n−1)p (type 7/INC), Tukey hinges take the median of each half around the median, and EXC uses (n+1)p.
map.IQR 能说明什么？: What does the IQR tell you?
map.IQR 覆盖中间 50% 的数据，越大说明中间段越分散；它不像极差那样被单个极端: The IQR covers the middle 50% of the data; the larger it is, the more spread out the middle is, and unlike the range it is not inflated by a single extreme value.
map.数据里有重复值会影响分位数吗？: Do duplicate values affect the quartiles?
map.不会。位置由 n 与百分位决定，插值取的是排序后的相邻值，重复值只是让相邻位置上: No. The position depends on n and the percentile, and interpolation uses neighbouring sorted values; duplicates simply make adjacent positions equal, so the result remains self-consistent.
map.为什么 n=3 也能算？: Why can n=3 still be computed?
map.n=3 时位置为 0.5、1、1.5，Q1 与 Q3 通过插值得到，仍能刻画中间: With n=3 the positions are 0.5, 1 and 1.5, so Q1 and Q3 come from interpolation and still describe the middle 50%; but the smaller the sample the less stable the quartiles, and the page only guarantees the formula convention is correct.
